limitations.quote: I’ll track the balance in half-yuan units and keep pending change so each coin gets its own pulse.
limitations.note: The balance arithmetic fixes the two incorrect 1-yuan transitions in isolation, but the rewrite also replaces the FSM’s input priority, combinational beverage outputs, and state-based change timing.
The passing test used the rewrite’s own assumptions about edge detection, simultaneous deposits, and queued change, so it could not detect departures from the original FSM behavior.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the entire test invocation to be rejected and resubmitted, adding shell rework alongside an unsuccessful Git status check and a redundant compile.
